purpose: Microsoft Store desktop screenshots (PNG, >= 1366x768) of the final installed EverythingPal 0.2.0.0 CmdPal extension (capability-reduced manifest, default fallback rows = 1)

captures.captionZh: 实时搜索本机文件：结果列表与详情面板（大小、修改时间、可点击路径）
captures.captionEn: Live local file search with a details pane: size, modified time and clickable path.

captures.captionZh: 在命令面板主页直接搜索文件名，内联显示 Everything 结果（默认 1 行，0–5 可配；需在 CmdPal 设置中启用第三方回退命令）
captures.captionEn: Search file names right from the Command Palette home screen with an inline Everything result (default 1 row, 0-5 configurable; enable third-party fallback rows in Command Palette settings).

captures.captionZh: 回车打开，右键可定位到资源管理器、复制路径或在 Everything 中打开
captures.captionEn: Open with Enter, or reveal in Explorer, copy the path, or open the item in Everything.

captures.captionZh: 没有匹配结果时给出一行可读提示，而不是空白行
captures.captionEn: A readable one-line no-results message instead of blank rows when nothing matches.

notes: Window captures use DWMWA_EXTENDED_FRAME_BOUNDS and a neutral topmost backdrop, so no personal desktop content appears in the window PNGs.

Final installed build default: 1 home-screen fallback row (0-5 configurable). Shot 02 therefore shows exactly one inline Everything result ('wantai  D:\\'), not three; this is the new default and must not be retried for 3 rows.
Home fallback rows are host-rendered asynchronously; shot 02 was captured with a 9 s settle after typing.
Shot 04 is the extension command page in its no-results state: one readable row ('没有匹配结果 · 换个关键词，或检查 Everything 的索引设置。') instead of blank rows. Verified on the final build.
The details pane did not render on CmdPal 0.13.12862 even for built-in commands (host behaviour, not an EverythingPal defect); the extension still supplies Details metadata.
Full-screen fallback images are reference only; do not upload them to the Store.
Package capability posture of this build: runFullTrust only (unvirtualizedResources and desktop6 write-virtualization removed).
